content.value_statement: Market research often requires many separate tools and checks. Longbridge Intel gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured workflows for Longbridge market analysis.
actual_capabilities: Routes market questions to reference workflows for screeners, rankings, movers, anomalies, and constituents.
Guides Longbridge CLI use with structured flags and JSON output where available.
Provides frameworks for ETF analysis, sector rotation, catalysts, events, and microstructure.
Supports Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English response guidance.
Includes error handling for missing CLI tools, login errors, and unavailable data.
limitations: Requires Longbridge CLI access or an available MCP fallback for live data.
Results depend on Longbridge data coverage, command support, and symbol availability.
Does not place trades or provide personalized investment advice.
Some workflows require the agent to calculate metrics from returned market data.

use_cases.title: Screen Stock Ideas
use_cases.description: Find saved screeners, rankings, movers, and catalysts before building a watchlist.

use_cases.title: Prepare Market Briefings
use_cases.description: Turn movers, news drivers, events, and sector signals into a concise daily briefing.

use_cases.title: Monitor ETF and Sector Signals
use_cases.description: Compare ETF liquidity, flows, tracking quality, holdings, and rotation signals.

prompt_templates.title: Check Today's Movers
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the top movers in the US market. Include the likely news driver, market tag, and a short risk note.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Screener
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Longbridge Intel to list available screener strategies, then run a growth or quality strategy for Hong Kong stocks.

prompt_templates.title: Build ETF Comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze SPY.US against its benchmark. Cover product profile, tracking error, liquidity, premium or discount, and allocation fit.

prompt_templates.title: Create Sector Rotation Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Combine sector rotation, ETF flow, catalyst, and microstructure workflows for semiconductors. Summarize strength, risks, and watchlist names.

output_examples.input: Show top movers in the US market.
output: A ranked list of unusual movers with price direction, reason summary, and related news context.
A short note separates technical anomaly signals from news-backed movement explanations.
A five-part ETF report covering profile, tracking error, liquidity, premium or discount, and allocation fit.
The report states data limits and includes a clear non-advice notice.
An industry panorama with scope, leading companies, valuation range, catalysts, risks, and investment angle.
The summary labels symbols, markets, and data sources for easier review.

best_practices: Use structured Longbridge output when calculations or comparisons are required.
Ask users to confirm symbols and markets when identifiers are ambiguous.
State the data source, time window, and non-advice limitation in financial summaries.
anti_patterns: Do not present generated conclusions as personalized investment advice.
Do not hide Longbridge CLI errors or silently retry with unrelated data sources.
Do not mix markets or currencies without labeling exposure and exchange.

faq.question: What does Longbridge Intel help analyze?
faq.answer: It helps analyze screeners, rankings, movers, anomalies, constituents, ETFs, sectors, catalysts, and industry themes.

faq.question: Does it require a Longbridge login?
faq.answer: The main skill says listed CLI commands are public, but local tooling and data access can still affect results.

faq.question: Can it answer in Chinese and English?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill asks the agent to match Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, or English input.

faq.question: Can it place trades?
faq.answer: No. It is a read-only research and analysis skill and does not execute trades.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: How current is the market data?
faq.answer: Freshness depends on Longbridge data availability and the command output at query time.
